decisions.reason: The source selects the Zapier subscription plan, while this Requirement concerns the separate MeetAlfred platform and already has its own Pro plan decision.
The lead-transfer path and its Sales Navigator subscription history are unaffected by the selected Zapier Pro plan and absence of Zapier add-ons.
The source does not change silent-lead recirculation, MeetAlfred export behavior, or the manual-cleanup constraint.
Selecting a Zapier subscription plan does not necessarily change the deferred synchronization Requirement, its connected platforms, or its Zapier integration method.
The Zapier plan selection does not resolve or alter how existing CRM records are shown to users.
The selected Zapier plan and add-on status do not change which communication channels must be visible in HubSpot lead records.
The Zapier subscription decision does not resolve or change whether LinkedIn profile URLs are transferred to the CRM.
